text:
Lia: Quick sync — we're pushing a new battlecard for launch next week. Main goal: clear rebuttals vs cloud AI platforms and infra vendors, and a tight webinar hook.

Omar: Draft claim: "Predictable inference economics: same API across hosted/dedicated/private with 30–60% lower per-token cost at production scale." Is the range too precise? :thinking:

Tess: I like it. For the webinar hook we can lead with "How we keep latency predictable as you scale" and show a lightweight bench vs Cloud A + self-host.

Ben: One-liner for SDRs: "Ship LLM features with production-grade latency and predictable costs." Shorter variant: "Predictable latency. Predictable cost." :thumbsup:

Raj: Sales asks: include procurement objection block — "we already use cloud managed endpoints" + response: "Redwood unifies runtime while improving unit economics, with SLA-backed Dedicated and Private deploy options." Also call out security/KMS fit.

Omar: I pushed a bench slide to the drive: https://rwd.in/g/benchslides. Key datapoints to surface: 95th latency, throughput per GPU, long-context cost per 1M tokens, and fallback behavior under load.

Tess: Please add test rig details to the footnote. If we can't share actual accounts, use "equivalent instance families" language and a short note about tokenization parity so claims are defensible.

Lia: We also need a 90s launch post copy. Draft: "Meet Redwood Inference: Ship LLM features faster with production economics that scale — predictable latency, graceful fallbacks, and one API across hosted, dedicated, and private deployments." Thoughts?

Raj: Love it. Add a procurement-ready one-liner: "Dedicated pools and a private control plane for regulated workloads; enterprise contracts include SLA, audit logs, and support."

Ben: For inbound routing, please tag leads by interest: "benchmark-webinar" and "private-deploy" — Ben (me) will create routing rules in HubSpot.

Tess: Webinar plan: 30m talk + 15m live Q&A, bench deep-dive + 1 short customer case. Need one customer willing to share numbers on latency/cost. @Raj can you surface candidates?

Raj: I'll ping two pilot customers today. @Ben please hold routing until we have signed permission to publish numbers / NDA in place.

copybot: Automod: Reminder — attach final slide deck to the campaign doc or autocat will flag the asset for manual review.

Lia: Next steps: Omar revise claims to be defensible and tighten the percent phrasing, Tess finalize slide footnotes and test rig language, Raj secure customer approval, Ben set routing tags but DO NOT activate. Check-in tomorrow 10:00am PT. :calendar:

Omar: On it, will update by EOD. :white_check_mark:
